items.title: 14.4 Simple harmonic motion aur uniform circular motion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4 with Figs 14.4-14.7 and Example 14.3 (PDF 25-28).

blocks.text: S.H.M ko achhi tarah samajhne ke liye hum ise uniform circular motion (ek jaisi speed se circle mein ghoomna) se jorte hain, jo hum pehle parh chuke hain. S.H.M ke displacement, velocity, acceleration aur time period ko circular motion se jor kar asaani se samjha ja sakta hai. Jab koi particle (zarra) circle (daira) mein ghoomta hai to us ki projection (saya) circle ke diameter par S.H.M karti hai.
Is ke liye radius r wala ek turntable lein jis ke rim (kinara) par ek ball (gend) lagi ho. Roshni ki beam (shua) ball ka shadow (saya) screen par dalti hai (Fig. 14.4).

Jab turntable constant angular speed ω se ghoomta hai to ball bhi uniform circular motion karti hai. Screen par us ka shadow aage peeche jhoolta hai, bilkul spring se bandhi body ki tarah: yeh simple harmonic motion hai.

blocks.alt: Projector ki roshni oopar se turntable par parti hai jis ke rim par ball lagi hai; mura teer ball ki circular motion dikhata hai. Neeche screen par ball ka shadow (saya) aage peeche chalta hai: oscillation of ball's shadow.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.4: Screen par ball ke shadow ka jhoolna. Ball ek jaisi speed se ghoomti turntable se lagi hai (kitab ki Figure 14.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
